comment: Same process under two names. GO names the carbon substrate, FAPROTAX the electron donor; hydrogenotrophic methanogenesis IS CO2 reduction with H2, which is why FAPROTAX's own methanogenesis_by_CO2_reduction_with_H2 is carried here as a synonym rather than a sibling class.
Direct equivalent. GO uses 'catabolic process' where FAPROTAX uses 'degradation'.
Direct equivalent; xylanolysis is the FAPROTAX spelling of xylan catabolism.

closeMatch rather than exact: GO:0019417 admits phototrophic sulfur oxidation, which the FAPROTAX 'dark' qualifier exists to exclude. The proposed term is narrower, but GO has no light-independent sibling to point at.
